brief: Goldman's Prime Services tracks hedge fund performance on Oct 30 in two snapshots. At noon, a broad equity selloff led by Tech (NDX down over 3%) hit momentum and growth factors, pushing Global Fundamental L/S down 1.2% (-1.8 SD, -3.6% MTD, +9% YTD) on beta and Info Tech exposure, with TMT-focused funds hit hardest at -3.8% (-2.6 SD, -12.6% MTD, cutting YTD to +5.1%). Asia-focused funds were down 1.2% intraday, -9.5% MTD, still +14% YTD. Global Systematic L/S fell 0.6% (-1.5 SD), losses from Asia and Europe partly offset by US gains, momentum/crowding/short-signal drags pushing MTD to -3.5%, on track for its first negative month of the year despite +16% YTD. By the close, markets had recovered partially but still finished lower, so Fundamental managers trimmed losses (Fundamental -0.85%, -3.3% MTD; TMT -3.1%, -11.9% MTD; US -0.8%; Europe -0.5%), while Systematic (Quants) slipped slightly further to -0.7%, -3.7% MTD, and Multi-Strats (4.5x leverage, no fees) finished flat, -0.9% MTD.
